doc.title: Louie Bellson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Opening of the Sarasota interview
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Bellson and asks how his career began.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Sarasota Florida, and it is an extreme, great pleasure to have Louie Bellson with us, drummer extraordinaire and band leader and arranger. Welcome.

You have just about done it all in your career, and you’re still doing it, as I just had the pleasure of hearing. How did all this come about? Did you start as a piano player as a child? Did I read that?
